verdict.rationale: Baseten is an inference and training platform, and in-product AI insights on a user's workspace data is a fair question for it, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only developer building blocks: hosted model APIs, structured outputs and function calling that a user could use to build insight features. Usage and budget dashboards report consumption but are not AI-generated insights. No first-party feature that generates insights or suggestions from the user's data inside the product is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
